examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Ancestor segment rendered as a link with muted label text.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import BreadcrumbItem from '@aziontech/webkit/breadcrumb-item'
</script>

<template>
  <BreadcrumbItem
    label="Page Name"
    href="#"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Current
examples.summary: Current page segment: rendered as a span with `aria-current="page"` and default (non-muted) text.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import BreadcrumbItem from '@aziontech/webkit/breadcrumb-item'
</script>

<template>
  <BreadcrumbItem
    label="Current Page"
    current
  />
</template>

examples.name: WithIcon
examples.summary: Segment with a leading PrimeIcons icon before the label.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import BreadcrumbItem from '@aziontech/webkit/breadcrumb-item'
</script>

<template>
  <BreadcrumbItem
    label="Page Name"
    href="#"
    show-icon
    icon="pi pi-box"
  />
</template>
